approval_request_no_self_approval.name: approval_request_no_self_approval
approval_request_no_self_approval.value: "approval_request"."approver_id" IS NULL OR "approval_request"."approver_id" <> "approval_request"."requested_by" OR "approval_request"."self_applied" OR "approval_request"."approver_role_snapshot" IN ('owner', 'manager')

approval_request_decided_check.name: approval_request_decided_check
approval_request_decided_check.value: "approval_request"."status" NOT IN ('approved', 'rejected') OR ("approval_request"."approver_id" IS NOT NULL AND "approval_request"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

approval_request_refund_account_check.name: approval_request_refund_account_check
approval_request_refund_account_check.value: "approval_request"."refund_method" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'bank_transfer' OR ("approval_request"."refund_account_enc" IS NULL AND "approval_request"."refund_account_last4" IS NULL)

approval_request_refund_destination_not_.name: approval_request_refund_destination_not_approver
approval_request_refund_destination_not_.value: "approval_request"."type" <> 'refund' OR "approval_request"."approver_id" IS NULL OR "approval_request"."refund_destination_set_by" IS NULL OR "approval_request"."approver_id" <> "approval_request"."refund_destination_set_by" OR ("approval_request"."approver_role_snapshot" = 'owner' AND COALESCE("approval_request"."refund_method", 'cash') <> 'cash')

approval_request_foc_cancelled_check.name: approval_request_foc_cancelled_check
approval_request_foc_cancelled_check.value: ("approval_request"."foc_cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL) = ("approval_request"."foc_state" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'cancelled')

folio_line_limit_ref_required_check.name: folio_line_limit_ref_required_check
folio_line_limit_ref_required_check.value: ("folio_line"."category" <> 'room' AND "folio_line"."charge_code" IS DISTINCT FROM 'late_fee_as_night') OR "folio_line"."limit_ref_vnd" IS NOT NULL

folio_line_adjusts_group_check.name: folio_line_adjusts_group_check
folio_line_adjusts_group_check.value: ("folio_line"."category" = 'adjustment') = ("folio_line"."adjusts_group" IS NOT NULL) AND ("folio_line"."adjusts_group" IS NULL OR "folio_line"."adjusts_group" IN ('room', 'other', 'non_revenue'))

folio_line_sign_check.name: folio_line_sign_check
folio_line_sign_check.value: "folio_line"."reversal_of_id" IS NOT NULL OR ("folio_line"."category" IN ('discount', 'foc') AND "folio_line"."amount_vnd" <= 0) OR ("folio_line"."category" NOT IN ('discount', 'foc') AND "folio_line"."amount_vnd" >= 0) OR "folio_line"."category" = 'adjustment'

folio_line_reason_check.name: folio_line_reason_check
folio_line_reason_check.value: "folio_line"."reason" IS NULL OR char_length("folio_line"."reason") BETWEEN 3 AND 500

invoice_request_company_check.name: invoice_request_company_check
invoice_request_company_check.value: "invoice_request"."buyer_type" <> 'company' OR ("invoice_request"."company_name" IS NOT NULL AND "invoice_request"."tax_code" IS NOT NULL AND "invoice_request"."email" IS NOT NULL)

payment_amount_sign_check.name: payment_amount_sign_check
payment_amount_sign_check.value: ("payment"."type" = 'refund' AND "payment"."amount_vnd" < 0) OR ("payment"."type" <> 'refund' AND "payment"."amount_vnd" > 0) OR "payment"."reversal_of_id" IS NOT NULL

payment_refund_approval_check.name: payment_refund_approval_check
payment_refund_approval_check.value: ("payment"."type" = 'refund' AND ("payment"."approval_request_id" IS NOT NULL OR "payment"."reversal_of_id" IS NOT NULL)) OR ("payment"."type" <> 'refund' AND "payment"."approval_request_id" IS NULL)

payment_refund_not_requester_check.name: payment_refund_not_requester_check
payment_refund_not_requester_check.value: "payment"."approval_request_id" IS NULL OR ("payment"."approval_requested_by" IS NOT NULL AND "payment"."recorded_by" IS NOT NULL AND ("payment"."recorded_by" <> "payment"."approval_requested_by" OR ("payment"."recorded_by_role" = 'owner' AND "payment"."method" <> 'cash')))

payment_reconcile_separation_check.name: payment_reconcile_separation_check
payment_reconcile_separation_check.value: "payment"."reconciled_by" IS NULL OR "payment"."self_reconciled" OR ("payment"."reconciled_by" IS DISTINCT FROM "payment"."recorded_by" AND "payment"."reconciled_by" IS DISTINCT FROM "payment"."confirmed_by")

payment_cash_handover_not_self_check.name: payment_cash_handover_not_self_check
payment_cash_handover_not_self_check.value: NOT "payment"."self_reconciled" OR NOT ("payment"."method" = 'cash' AND COALESCE("payment"."recorded_by_role", '') IN ('sales_staff', 'collaborator'))

payment_recorded_by_role_required_check.name: payment_recorded_by_role_required_check
payment_recorded_by_role_required_check.value: "payment"."recorded_by" IS NULL OR "payment"."recorded_by_role" IS NOT NULL

payment_reconciled_by_check.name: payment_reconciled_by_check
payment_reconciled_by_check.value: ("payment"."reconciliation" NOT IN ('reconciled', 'disputed') OR "payment"."reconciled_by" IS NOT NULL) AND ("payment"."reconciled_by" IS NULL OR "payment"."reconciled_by_role" IS NOT NULL)

guest_id_doc_hmac_uk.name: guest_id_doc_hmac_uk
guest_id_doc_hmac_uk.where: "guest"."id_doc_hmac" IS NOT NULL AND "guest"."merged_into_id" IS NULL AND "guest"."anonymized_at" IS NULL

guest_contact_source_check.name: guest_contact_source_check
guest_contact_source_check.value: "guest"."source" <> 'desk' OR "guest"."phone_e164" IS NOT NULL OR "guest"."email_norm" IS NOT NULL OR "guest"."anonymized_at" IS NOT NULL OR "guest"."merged_into_id" IS NOT NULL

guest_document_minimal_check.name: guest_document_minimal_check
guest_document_minimal_check.value: "guest"."source" <> 'document' OR "guest"."crm_consent" = 'granted' OR ("guest"."date_of_birth" IS NULL AND "guest"."gender" IS NULL AND "guest"."id_doc_last4" IS NULL AND "guest"."id_doc_hmac" IS NULL AND "guest"."free_note" IS NULL AND coalesce(cardinality("guest"."tags"), 0) = 0 AND coalesce(cardinality("guest"."service_notes"), 0) = 0)

room_public_room_type_check.name: room_public_room_type_check
room_public_room_type_check.value: "room"."public_room_type" IS NULL OR char_length("room"."public_room_type") BETWEEN 1 AND 60

hk_task_kit_reservation_check.name: hk_task_kit_reservation_check
hk_task_kit_reservation_check.value: "hk_task"."type" NOT LIKE 'extra_guest_kit_%' OR ("hk_task"."reservation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "hk_task"."source" = 'system')

hk_task_cancel_note_check.name: hk_task_cancel_note_check
hk_task_cancel_note_check.value: "hk_task"."cancel_reason_code" IS DISTINCT FROM 'other' OR ("hk_task"."cancel_note" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("hk_task"."cancel_note") <> '')

overbooking_incident_resolved_check.name: overbooking_incident_resolved_check
overbooking_incident_resolved_check.value: "overbooking_incident"."status" <> 'resolved' OR ("overbooking_incident"."resolution" IS NOT NULL AND "overbooking_incident"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

reservation_cancelled_check.name: reservation_cancelled_check
reservation_cancelled_check.value: "reservation"."status" <> 'cancelled' OR ("reservation"."cancel_reason_code" IS NOT NULL AND "reservation"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL)

reservation_deposit_shortfall_check.name: reservation_deposit_shortfall_check
reservation_deposit_shortfall_check.value: ("reservation"."deposit_shortfall_accepted_at" IS NULL AND "reservation"."deposit_shortfall_vnd" IS NULL AND "reservation"."deposit_shortfall_accepted_by" IS NULL AND "reservation"."deposit_shortfall_reason" IS NULL) OR ("reservation"."deposit_shortfall_accepted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "reservation"."deposit_shortfall_vnd" > 0 AND "reservation"."deposit_shortfall_accepted_by" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("reservation"."deposit_shortfall_reason") BETWEEN 3 AND 500)

reservation_debt_check.name: reservation_debt_check
reservation_debt_check.value: ("reservation"."debt_due_date" IS NULL AND "reservation"."debt_reason" IS NULL) OR ("reservation"."checkout_mode" = 'debt' AND "reservation"."debt_due_date" IS NOT NULL AND "reservation"."debt_reason" IS NOT NULL)

stay_night_void_check.name: stay_night_void_check
stay_night_void_check.value: "stay_night"."night_state" <> 'void' OR ("stay_night"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "stay_night"."void_reason" IN ('hold_expired', 'cancelled', 'no_show', 'early_departure', 'lease_terminated', 'date_change', 'relocated_external', 'channel_cancelled') AND "stay_night"."prev_state" IN ('hold', 'sold'))

item_price_check.name: item_price_check
item_price_check.value: ("item"."cost_price_vnd" IS NULL OR "item"."cost_price_vnd" >= 0) AND ("item"."sale_price_vnd" IS NULL OR "item"."sale_price_vnd" >= 0)

minibar_fill_line_price_check.name: minibar_fill_line_price_check
minibar_fill_line_price_check.value: ("minibar_fill_line"."unit_price_vnd_snapshot" IS NULL OR "minibar_fill_line"."unit_price_vnd_snapshot" >= 0) AND ("minibar_fill_line"."unit_cost_vnd_snapshot" IS NULL OR "minibar_fill_line"."unit_cost_vnd_snapshot" >= 0)

attention_event_resolved_check.name: attention_event_resolved_check
attention_event_resolved_check.value: "attention_event"."resolved_by" IS NULL OR "attention_event"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL

checkout_confirmation_time_check.name: checkout_confirmation_time_check
checkout_confirmation_time_check.value: "checkout_confirmation"."reply_type" NOT IN ('time', 'late') OR "checkout_confirmation"."confirmed_time" IS NOT NULL

reservation_guest_guest_uk.name: reservation_guest_guest_uk
reservation_guest_guest_uk.where: "reservation_guest"."removed_at" IS NULL AND "reservation_guest"."guest_id" IS NOT NULL

reservation_guest_child_uk.name: reservation_guest_child_uk
reservation_guest_child_uk.where: "reservation_guest"."removed_at" IS NULL AND "reservation_guest"."child_name_hmac" IS NOT NULL

reservation_guest_removed_check.name: reservation_guest_removed_check
reservation_guest_removed_check.value: "reservation_guest"."removed_by" IS NULL OR "reservation_guest"."removed_at" IS NOT NULL

reservation_guest_subject_check.name: reservation_guest_subject_check
reservation_guest_subject_check.value: ("reservation_guest"."role" = 'companion' AND "reservation_guest"."guest_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reservation_guest"."child_name_enc" IS NULL) OR ("reservation_guest"."role" = 'child' AND "reservation_guest"."guest_id" IS NULL AND "reservation_guest"."child_name_enc" IS NOT NULL AND "reservation_guest"."child_data_key_id" IS NOT NULL)

attachment_reservation_check.name: attachment_reservation_check
attachment_reservation_check.value: "attachment"."purpose" NOT IN ('deposit_receipt', 'penalty_evidence') OR "attachment"."reservation_id" IS NOT NULL

guest_document_booker_uk.name: guest_document_booker_uk
guest_document_booker_uk.where: "guest_document"."guest_id" IS NOT NULL AND "guest_document"."removed_at" IS NULL

guest_request_t13_idx.name: guest_request_t13_idx
guest_request_t13_idx.where: "guest_request"."note" IS NOT NULL OR "guest_request"."reply_note" IS NOT NULL

guest_request_declined_other_check.name: guest_request_declined_other_check
guest_request_declined_other_check.value: "guest_request"."declined_reason_code" IS DISTINCT FROM 'other' OR "guest_request"."note_purged_at" IS NOT NULL OR ("guest_request"."reply_note" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("guest_request"."reply_note") <> '')

guest_request_fee_check.name: guest_request_fee_check
guest_request_fee_check.value: "guest_request"."fee_vnd_snapshot" IS NULL OR ("guest_request"."fee_vnd_snapshot" > 0 AND "guest_request"."fee_accepted_at" IS NOT NULL)

guest_request_ack_check.name: guest_request_ack_check
guest_request_ack_check.value: "guest_request"."acknowledged_by" IS NULL OR "guest_request"."acknowledged_at" IS NOT NULL
